page.notes: The marginal notes read "ala-critas" (hyphen at the line end, kept) and "Sacerdotis dira imprecatio"; both are placed where their lines stand. The word "moratio" at the foot is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The reading "cum irridentes" and the spelling "acmeas" are as printed; the scan is clear enough to read them. The final line is a catchword continuation, so the word "commoratio" is split as "com-" in the text. The running head is split into two parts, the author's name left and the title right. No page number is printed.
